raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Experienced Data Architect & Data Engineering Manager in Data & Platform Engineering, leading, solutioning different projects using skills such as Azure Tech Stack, Snowflake, Architecture and data modelling. Passionate in solving things by providing real time solutions. Strong in business domains such as medical, retail, oil and gas. Seeking opportunities to innovate data-driven solutions by leveraging skills to deliver significant performance enhancements.
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Architect (Senior Specialist Engineer) AT&T Inc. | October 2025 - Present, Hyderabad
The American Telephone and Telegraph Company, is an American multinational telecommunications holding company
Proposed migration plan for GWS project (Global Workspaces), to move the legacy on-premise data to Azure cloud, reducing security and compliance risk by 70%.
Championed the design of Azure Solutions and infrastructures for 3.9k clients using Databricks, Python, Pyspark, SQL, Data Modeling and Java.
Architected Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipelines in Databricks to automate ingestion, transformation, and data quality enforcement across the GWS migration, improving pipeline reliability and reducing manual maintenance effort.
Managed 11+ folks as subject lead, ensuring they delivered project 15% under the project and in compliance with the deadline.
Led hiring and interviewing for open roles on the data architecture team, and designed structured onboarding plans that accelerated new-hire ramp-up time.
Owned people management for the team including 1:1s, performance feedback, and career development planning, fostering a high-engagement, high-retention team culture.
Implemented DMAAP file-based publish-subscribe messaging, pushing published files to subscribers in real time as soon as they were generated — architecturally similar to Kafka pub-sub.
Provided technical expertise to 15 sales team members during proposal discussions and presentations to customers; achieved a 70% success rate for deals closed.
Data Engineering Manager PepsiCo | December 2022 - September 2025, Hyderabad, India
Built data pipelines which enhanced data movement from SAP to Gold layer using ADF and CI-CD for versioning, increasing the data load by 30%.
Spearheaded Labor-Cost Forecast tool project, predicting 95% data using Random Forest AI and ML models.
Leveraged systems table in Databricks to understand cost utilization and compare costs for job, interactive, SQL warehouse and serverless compute.
Implemented Unity Catalog to enhance data lineage and governance by migrating from Hive metastore to UC-enabled tables.
Built and scaled the data engineering team by leading hiring, screening, and interviewing efforts across multiple roles.
Designed and rolled out an onboarding program for new hires covering tooling, architecture standards, and domain knowledge, reducing time-to-productivity.
Managed direct reports end-to-end, including performance reviews, career development plans, and mentorship, driving strong team retention and growth.
Reduced $1.2M capex and operational costs for the company, by migrating towards serverless compute.
Calculated the realizations for compute costs by recommending the optimal clusters for every project across PepsiCo. Realized $0.8M for last half-yearly savings. Derived Observability dashboard to showcase Cluster cost by compute, workspaces, environments, Sectors which gives management a holistic view on resource costing.
Data Engineer Anheuser Busch InBev | September 2021 - December 2022, Bengaluru, India
'@3 Scanned with OKEN Scanner
e Led the architecture and migration of 95% on-premise data to Azure Cloud using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Databricks (ADB), enabling scalable and cost-efficient data pipelines.
e Designed and executed a comprehensive data validation and testing strategy for all in-scope reports, ensuring high data quality and accuracy post-migration.
e Built a robust automation framework for data quality checks including null validations, record counts, schema validation, and aggregation checks — reducing manual QA effort by 45%.
e Mentored junior QA engineers, supporting their growth through task allocation, technical guidance, and roadblock resolution.
e Engineered scalable storage solutions leveraging Azure Data Lake to centralize 2TB of daily ingested data across 10+ pipelines, improving data accessibility and analytical processing speed by 60% over 18 months.
e Integrated Azure Synapse Analytics with existing Azure Data Lake architecture to unify batch and real-time analytics on 2TB daily data, reducing dashboard latency by 35% and supporting downstream reporting.
e Managed migration of 1PB historical data to Azure Blob Storage over 12 months using AzCopy and Python scripts, optimizing storage costs by 40% and supporting seamless integration with ADF-based ETL workflows.
Senior Software Engineer Seanergy Digital | December 2020 - September 2021, Hyderabad, India e Simplified various Power BI dashboards, using data from SQL server. e Created SQL stored procedures to derive the Key KPIs to be populated on Power BI reports. e Migrated to serverless Azure SQL DB to enhance data reads by 45% increase in querying time. e
Built a robust automation framework for data quality checks including null validations, record counts, schema validation, and aggregation checks — reducing manual QA effort by 45%.
Quality Analyst TechnipFMC | July 2015 - December 2020, Hyderabad, India
e Designed and managed Hive tables using HiveQL, handling and analyzing over 5 TB of data to support data-driven decision-making across organizational projects.
e Leveraged Big Data technologies including Apache Spark, HDFS, and Hive to process and optimize workflows for 25+ PB of data annually, resulting in a 15% reduction in operational costs and improved efficiency.
e Spearheaded Labor-Cost Forecast tool project, predicting 95% data using Random Forest AI and ML models.
